description: This file defines the interface LogEntryBuilder, which is a mutable builder with a fluent API for constructing LogEntry instances within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for setting various properties of a log entry, such as correlation ID, timestamp, category, type, level, message, address, and thing ID.

classes.name: LogEntryBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface for constructing LogEntry objects with a fluent API, allowing setting of log properties such as correlation ID, timestamp, category, type, level, message, address, and associated Thing ID.

methods.name: correlationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID associated with the log entry; returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the log entry; returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: logCategory
methods.description: Sets the category of the log entry; returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: logType
methods.description: Sets the type of the log entry; returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level; returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Sets the log message; returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets the address related to the log entry, if applicable; returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: thingId
methods.description: Sets the Thing ID if applicable; returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the LogEntry object based on the set properties.
